# configuration file /etc/pw-multi/nginx.conf:
# Hand-written: several virtual hosts, an upstream file under conf.d, sites-enabled
# symlinks, every *_pass kind, nested locations and a stream block.
user www-data;
worker_processes 1;
pid /run/pw-multi.pid;
load_module /usr/lib/nginx/modules/ngx_stream_module.so;

events {
	worker_connections 64;
}

http {
	include /etc/pw-multi/conf.d/*.conf;
	include sites-enabled/*;
}

stream {
	upstream pg {
		server 127.0.0.1:5432;
		server 10.0.0.9:5432 backup;
	}
	server {
		listen 15432;
		proxy_pass pg;
	}
	server {
		listen 127.0.0.1:1053 udp;
		proxy_pass 127.0.0.53:53;
	}
}

# configuration file /etc/pw-multi/conf.d/upstreams.conf:
upstream app {
	server 127.0.0.1:8000 weight=3;
	server 127.0.0.1:8001 backup;
	server unix:/run/app.sock;
	keepalive 16;
}

upstream api_v2 {
	server [::1]:9002;
	server localhost:9003 down;
}

# configuration file /etc/pw-multi/sites-enabled/api.conf:
server {
	listen 80;
	listen [::]:80;
	server_name api.example.com api2.example.com;
	root /var/www/api;

	location / {
		proxy_pass http://app;
		proxy_set_header Host $host;
		add_header X-Note "a;b{c}#d"; # quoted ; { } and # are not syntax
	}

	location /v2/ {
		proxy_pass http://api_v2/;
	}

	location = /admin {
		proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:9000/admin;
	}

	# a comment with a { brace
	location ~ \.php$ {
		include fastcgi_params;
		fastcgi_pass unix:/run/php/php8.3-fpm.sock;
	}

	location /grpc {
		grpc_pass grpc://127.0.0.1:50051;
	}

	location /py {
		include uwsgi_params;
		uwsgi_pass 127.0.0.1:3031;
	}

	location /scgi {
		scgi_pass 127.0.0.1:4000;
	}

	location /cache {
		set $memcached_key "$uri?$args";
		memcached_pass 127.0.0.1:11211;
	}

	location /static/ {
		alias /srv/static/;
	}

	location /api {
		location /api/internal {
			proxy_pass http://127.0.0.1:7000;
		}
		proxy_pass http://localhost:7001;
	}
}

# configuration file /etc/pw-multi/fastcgi_params:
fastcgi_param  QUERY_STRING       $query_string;
fastcgi_param  SCRIPT_FILENAME    $document_root$fastcgi_script_name;

# configuration file /etc/pw-multi/uwsgi_params:
uwsgi_param  QUERY_STRING       $query_string;

# configuration file /etc/pw-multi/sites-enabled/tls.conf:
server {
	listen 443 ssl default_server;
	listen [::]:443 ssl default_server;
	server_name _;
	ssl_certificate /etc/ssl/certs/ssl-cert-snakeoil.pem;
	ssl_certificate_key /etc/ssl/private/ssl-cert-snakeoil.key;
	return 444;
}

server {
	listen 127.0.0.1:8081;
	server_name internal.local;

	location / {
		root /var/www/internal;
		index index.html;
	}
}
